title: Amicable Knots on Minimal Genus Seifert Surfaces
summary: For a knot $K\subset S^3$, let $S(K)$ denote the set of non-trivial knot types represented by simple closed curves on a minimal genus Seifert surface of $K$. We study the relation $J\in S(K)$ and its symmetric part, which leads to the notion of \emph{amicable knots}: knots $K$ and $J$ are called amicable if each is represented by a simple closed curve on a minimal genus Seifert surface of the other.
